steps: 1. Start from the verified continuation and preserve completed evidence. Use the new worker's budget.clock_command before each substantial batch and after checks. Update progress.md within 600 words to identify this single task and replace obsolete deadline instructions; do not repeat the completed five-case reporting.

2. Create docs/design/proposal/architecture/uncertainty-representation-comparison-v1.md and uncertainty-representation-fixtures-v1.json. Pin the attachment v2 contract/fixtures and prerequisite supplement by path and hash. Scope the question to whether family-linked and self-contained joint-model records preserve the same finite attachment, overlapping-event and projection semantics. Do not register uncertainty as a completed contract.

3. Save the comparison's common semantic requirements first. Hold family/view versions, elementary outcomes, coordinates, masses, selectors, purpose, cutoffs, provenance, admission status and dependency versions fixed. Define the family-linked representation through exact external references. Define the self-contained representation through embedded immutable definitions and an explicit versioned mapping to the family. Distinguish encoding identities from semantic identities. State what 'self-contained' includes and which external source obligations remain referenced.

4. Add a field-by-field correspondence covering inputs, outputs, invariants, ownership, dependencies, failure obligations and interactions with histories, time, language/IR, persistence and interfaces. Define equivalence by preserved semantic content and event results, not identical serialised bytes. Embedded copies must retain origin identity/version/hash; packaging must not create new evidence, admission or probability. Explain lost-information conditions for projections and why a displayed projection cannot replace elementary identities.

5. Save three paired examples, reusing MA02a, MA03a and MA04b as the matched baselines. Supply concrete inputs and expected receipts for both representations, with exact dependency bindings and explicit representation-to-semantic mappings. MA02a retains masses 1/2, 1/3 and 1/6 and attachment as a synthetic assumption. MA03a preserves event probabilities 5/6 and 1/2, intersection 1/3 and union 1. MA04b preserves both elementary outcomes even though their rate=1 projection has mass 1. Do not merely point both alternatives at the same existing request and call that a comparison.

6. Compare shared identity, export completeness, duplicated definitions, revision ownership, dependency availability and unresolved obligations using those same examples. Give each alternative a credible mitigation for its weaknesses. State a provisional recommendation only to the extent supported by the comparison; leave final architecture and profile selection open. Record provenance, justification, failure mode, early diagnostic and provisional status for material encoding choices. Detailed stale-version and malformed-input receipts remain the next task.

7. Perform bounded document checks using existing standard-library tools, without adding runtime modules or a test suite. Parse the new JSON; verify reference hashes and exact embedded/reference correspondence; resolve every claimed available record; recompute finite masses and event/projection results with fractions.Fraction directly from inputs. Check status dimensions and preserved elementary identities separately from arithmetic. Save the command, inspected inputs, observations and limitations in a fresh uncertainty-representation-verification-v1.json.

8. Register the subsection as partial work in architecture.json, retaining all existing references, six unfinished contracts and fourteen decisions. Update result.md and progress.md with actual outputs, changed-file paths, checks and remaining work. Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/check_accounting_proposal.py --phase P16 --check into a fresh task-local structural-report filename; validate nonempty JSON and inspect failures. Expect the incomplete whole-contract inventory to remain a phase-level failure; investigate any additional failure without relaxing the checker.

9. Stop after the comparison, three paired examples, bounded verification and partial registration are saved. Return PARTIAL, distinguishing subsection completion from failed full-phase checks. At the clock's finish stage, stop drafting and perform only bounded checks/checkpoint updates; at respond, return immediately. If the subsection is unfinished, identify the exact missing mapping or example rather than restarting the broader attachment plan.
